theme: operator session GECOS/FULLNAME + TTYNAME + ISATTY gate

tests.name: tty_pipe
tests.cmd: TTYNAME OUT empty under pipe; REQUIRE→2

tests.name: gate_tty_require
tests.cmd: gate tty REQUIRE → exit 2 under pipe

weaknesses.title: TTYNAME empty is OK=1 not soft-fail — dual with ISATTY
weaknesses.detail: Under pipes TTYNAME OUT is empty LAST_N=0 OK=1. Agents treating OK as present stamp blank paths. Must dual-check LAST_N or ISATTY.
weaknesses.repro: TTYNAME OUT under pipe → OK=1 empty

weaknesses.title: CTTY vs TTYNAME OUT disagree under redirected stdout
weaknesses.detail: stamp saw ctty=/dev/tty while tty_out empty. Controlling tty exists but stream is not a tty. Agents conflating CTTY with interactive OUT.
weaknesses.repro: TTYNAME CTRL non-empty; TTYNAME OUT empty; ISATTY OUT 0

weaknesses.title: GECOS/FULLNAME collapse to USER when passwd comment empty
weaknesses.detail: root:x:0:0:root:… yields name_eq_user=1. No HAS_REAL_GECOS bit; agents cannot tell missing human name from intentional same-as-login.

weaknesses.title: GECOS office fields after comma unused — no GECOS_FIELD n peel
weaknesses.detail: FULLNAME peels first field only. Room/phone in GECOS need BEFORE/AFTER hand parse.

weaknesses.title: Gate mode HAS false friends (notty contains tty)
weaknesses.detail: HAS notty tty → 1. Board hand-rolls no-prefix. Prefer EQS batch|tty.

weaknesses.title: ISATTY stream default undocumented for agents
weaknesses.detail: ISATTY bare vs OUT/IN/ERR; TTYNAME stream arg names CTRL vs default differ. Easy mismatch when dual-probing.

weaknesses.title: WRITE metas omit trailing NL
weaknesses.detail: VAL short stamps glue in cat -A.

workarounds: Dual ISATTY + TTYNAME LAST_N before stamping tty path
Prefer TTYNAME OUT for interactive gate; CTTY only for session id
Flag name_eq_user when FULLNAME==USER as unknown display
EQS gate modes batch|tty not HAS
language_gaps: TTYNAME empty soft-fail option or REQUIRE TTY form
Document CTTY vs stream TTYNAME semantics
issues_faced: CTTY=/dev/tty with OUT empty is core lesson
